newsitems.title: Squad Battle Returns on February 21, 2025
newsitems.author: KRAFTON Kruskay
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=byEvymg9Qzs;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Squad Battle is here![/b] Get ready for an intense showdown on [b]February 21st, 2025[/b], starting at [b]18:00 UTC[/b]. Two teams, featuring eight top content creators, will face off in [b]1v1 Arena duels and Battle Royale matches[/b], fighting for a [b]$10,000 USD[/b] and ultimate bragging rights.

[h1][b]Who are the Challengers?[/b][/h1]
	
Some of the best content creators are stepping up to the challenge!

	
	[table]					[tr]				[td]					
[b]Team DanucD[/b]
				[/td]				[td]					
[b]Team Glorious_E[/b]
				[/td]			[/tr]			[tr]				[td]					
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/danucd][u]DanucD[/u][/url]
				[/td]				[td]

				[/td]			[/tr]			[tr]				[td]					
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/eastahh][u]Eastahh[/u][/url]
				[/td]				[td]					
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/alisa][u]Alisa[/u][/url]
				[/td]			[/tr]			[tr]				[td]					
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/c_dome][u]C_Dome[/u][/url]
				[/td]				[td]					
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/lauraa][u]Lauraa[/u][/url]
				[/td]			[/tr]			[tr]				[td]					
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/halifax][u]Halifax[/u][/url]
				[/td]				[td]					
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/rollipollipotamus][u]Rollipollipotamus[/u][/url]
				[/td]			[/tr]			[/table]
	
Tune in live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pubg_battlegrounds][b]Twitch at /PUBG_BATTLEGROUNDS[/b][/url] to catch all the action, with POVs from each content creator’s stream—with the amazing TheBeardGuys as your host and caster!

And don’t miss out—G-Coin rewards will be up for grabs for viewers throughout the event!	
	
Find all the details and terms for our promotion [url=https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/content/news/20250214/DFpLh2ub/PUBG%20SQUAD%20BATTLE_3_Promotion%20Rules_final_250211.pdf]here[/url].

	
[h1][b]Predict your winner![/b][/h1]
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20250219/WHqtlxzH.jpg[/img]

	
Think you can predict the winners? Now’s your chance! Submit your predictions before the start of the Squad Battle eventfor a shot at winning [b]1,000 G-Coin[/b]! A total of [b]75 lucky winners[/b] will be chosen, so submit your prediction in while you can.
	
Predict now right here: [url=https://bit.ly/3WQ2RPw]https://bit.ly/3WQ2RPw[/url]

Who will be crowned Champion?

Don't miss the action on [b]February 21, starting at 18:00 UTC[/b] to witness the clash and experience the thrill live!
